items.text: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open multimodal model designed for nonstop enterprise-agent workloads.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 开放多模态模型，面向持续运行的企业智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Its open release lowers the barrier for enterprise teams building always-on multimodal agents, but deployment costs remain unclear.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放权重降低了企业构建多模态智能体的门槛，但持续运行成本仍未明朗。

items.text: Krea opened its Krea 3 beta, promising native 2K image edits in under eight seconds with LoRA and style-reference support.
items.text_zh: Krea 开放 Krea 3 测试版，支持原生 2K 图像编辑、LoRA 与风格参考，处理时间低于八秒。
items.cat_take_en: Sub-eight-second 2K editing targets professional iteration speed, though the beta’s quality claims still await broader benchmarks.
items.cat_take_zh: 八秒内完成 2K 编辑直击专业迭代效率，但测试版质量仍需更多独立基准验证。

items.text: ElevenLabs said blind listeners preferred its Eleven v4 voice model over competing systems across eight languages.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 表示，盲测听众在八种语言中都更偏好其 Eleven v4 语音模型。
items.cat_take_en: The multilingual result strengthens ElevenLabs’ creator positioning, but the company-run test leaves independent reproduction unresolved.
items.cat_take_zh: 多语言结果强化了其创作者定位，但测试由公司主导，独立复现仍是悬念。

items.text: Kling 4.0 became fully available through Kling’s refreshed creation interface, expanding access to its latest video-generation tools.
items.text_zh: Kling 4.0 通过全新创作界面正式全面开放，用户可直接使用最新视频生成工具。
items.cat_take_en: Full availability shifts Kling from showcase to production tool, increasing pressure on rivals to match creator workflow polish.
items.cat_take_zh: 全面开放让 Kling 从展示模型进入生产工具阶段，竞争焦点将转向创作流程体验。

items.text: Luma introduced Shot Coverage, which turns one video shot into additional moving camera angles for editing.
items.text_zh: Luma 推出 Shot Coverage，可将单个视频镜头转换为多个可剪辑的运动机位。
items.cat_take_en: Generating coverage from existing footage can cut reshoot costs, but consistency across invented angles will determine professional adoption.
items.cat_take_zh: 从现有素材补拍机位可能降低重拍成本，但虚拟角度的一致性决定能否进入专业制作。

items.text: Sakana AI unveiled The Agentic Scientist, a system that orchestrates coding agents for automated scientific co-discovery.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 发布 Agentic Scientist，用编码智能体协同推进自动化科学发现。
items.cat_take_en: The system moves AI research beyond paper summarization toward experiment loops, while validation and attribution remain difficult.
items.cat_take_zh: 该系统把 AI 从论文总结推进到实验闭环，但成果验证与贡献归属仍很棘手。

items.text: Cognition introduced Devin Oncall, which investigates alerts and bugs and connects with Datadog, Dynatrace, Sentry, and similar tools.
items.text_zh: Cognition 推出 Devin Oncall，可调查告警与缺陷，并连接 Datadog、Dynatrace、Sentry 等工具。
items.cat_take_en: Integrating directly with observability stacks gives Devin a concrete production role, but autonomous remediation still needs strict controls.
items.cat_take_zh: 直接接入可观测性系统让 Devin 获得明确生产场景，但自动修复仍需严格权限控制。

items.text: Manus launched Automations, allowing users to schedule agent runs or trigger them from connected-app events.
items.text_zh: Manus 推出 Automations，支持按时间运行智能体，或由连接应用中的事件触发任务。
items.cat_take_en: Event-triggered agents turn Manus into workflow infrastructure, but reliability across long-running external actions is the key test.
items.cat_take_zh: 事件触发让 Manus 更像工作流基础设施，但跨应用长期执行的可靠性才是关键。

items.text: World Labs began rolling out Atlas beta access, including pixel-precise camera-path control for generated 3D worlds.
items.text_zh: World Labs 开始推送 Atlas 测试资格，并提供对生成式三维世界的像素级镜头路径控制。
items.cat_take_en: Precise camera control addresses a major weakness of generative worlds, making Atlas more useful for directed production than demos.
items.cat_take_zh: 精确镜头控制补上了生成式世界的关键短板，使 Atlas 更接近定向制作工具。

items.text: Google DeepMind described using Antigravity to accelerate antimicrobial-peptide discovery through AI-guided scientific search.
items.text_zh: Google DeepMind 介绍 Antigravity 如何通过 AI 引导科学搜索，加速抗菌肽发现。
items.cat_take_en: The work points to a high-value use of AI beyond chat, though laboratory validation remains the unavoidable bottleneck.
items.cat_take_zh: 这展示了 AI 超越聊天的高价值用途，但实验室验证仍是无法绕过的瓶颈。

items.text: AWS expanded Strands Decider with four Gemma sizes ranging from two billion to 26 billion parameters for agent routing decisions.
items.text_zh: AWS 为 Strands Decider 增加四种 Gemma 规模，覆盖二十亿至二百六十亿参数，用于智能体路由决策。
items.cat_take_en: Small routing models can reduce latency and cost, giving developers a practical alternative to sending every decision to frontier models.
items.cat_take_zh: 小型路由模型可降低延迟与成本，让开发者不必把每个决策都交给前沿模型。

items.text: Ideogram 4.5 added multi-turn editing at every price tier, with native 2K output ranging from $0.008 to $0.22 per image.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 4.5 在所有价格档位提供多轮编辑与原生 2K 输出，单张成本约为 0.008 至 0.22 美元。
items.cat_take_en: A wide price-performance ladder could broaden serious image editing, while users must trade speed and quality against budget.
items.cat_take_zh: 覆盖多档价格有望扩大专业图像编辑用户，但速度、质量与预算仍需取舍。

items.text: Archestra released OpenAPPA, a framework designed to reduce data leakage caused by prompt injection and model hallucinations.
items.text_zh: Archestra 发布 OpenAPPA，旨在降低提示词注入和模型幻觉引发的数据泄露风险。
items.cat_take_en: Treating prompt injection as an application-layer security problem is useful, but no framework eliminates unsafe tool permissions.
items.cat_take_zh: 把提示词注入视为应用层安全问题很有价值，但框架无法替代危险工具权限治理。
